items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Different ones would be playing their horns -- Dizzy and different ones. They'd come up with some funny passages and things, and it would sound real funny to me.

ctx.x: During this time when you were just gigging, I guess, did you feel that the music had changed a lot?

What do you mean? Oh yes, the music had changed. It started changing when I... The music started changing before I even got with Cootie's band, and that was in the early Forties. It started changing then. They were doing some Bop then, back in them days, with ...(?)... thing, and in Minton's Bar. Different ones would be playing their horns -- Dizzy and different ones. They'd come up with some funny passages and things, and it would sound real funny to me. Believe me, it sounded from way out, you know! But it was…
But Bop was never anything that you liked.
